existingRecords.coverage: Active modeled residents of this town employed as Police officer by service:police organizations. Excludes officers residing outside town; not all sworn officers serving jurisdiction.
First-day modeled town funded staff count; not empirical department baseline.
Serving government population; cannot automatically pair with modeled town resident officers.

requiredContract.numerator: Full sworn officer count serving precisely the covered jurisdiction, with source date and employment definition.
requiredContract.denominator: Same geographic population and date; must reconcile municipal/county/state overlapping services.
requiredContract.baseline: Positive same-unit initial density; missing or zero baseline must not invent relative growth.

elasticity.unit: Percent crime change per one percent sworn officer change.
elasticity.limits: Derived normal confidence intervals are sampling uncertainty, not empirical place-heterogeneity ranges. Not a direct coefficient per officer per1000.

baselineResearch: No matching nationwide jurisdiction baseline verified in this packet. FBI police employee tables are a research lead, not a claimed fetched source or universal number.
runtimeActivation: NOT RUN; source producer absent. Coordinator owns elasticity engine and shared map.

jurisdictionTrace.fundingGovernment: Own place budget if present; otherwise servingGovernment resolves county, township, consolidated county or state. Missing linkage returns null.
jurisdictionTrace.countSelection: fundedStaff always restricts employee homeJurisdictionId to town, even when funder is county or state.
jurisdictionTrace.populationSelection: Budget opening uses real government population sources; townResidents returns modeled living working-age people, not all residents.
jurisdictionTrace.safeConnection: No justified direct density reader from current records. A represented-jobs change could be a separately labeled model signal but is not empirically calibrated full officer density.
jurisdictionTrace.producerNeeded: Store full departmental sworn staffing with matching service geography and date, or a documented representative expansion factor with validation; neither found.
